APPROVE
The loop body moves into `JudgeCall` and `ResolveRoute` with the same checks in the same order, and every former `continue` now returns `null`, so `ExpressAndFastify` drops to a single `if` well under 15. The `is not var (path, receiver, middle)` pattern on the nullable tuple matches only a non-null result and leaves the three variables definitely assigned, so behaviour and the build should both hold, though I reviewed the diff only and did not compile it.
